#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    std::vector<int> typeCount(3, 0);
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> typePositions(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int t = (s[i] == 'K') ? 0 : (s[i] == 'V') ? 1 : 2;
        typePositions[t].push_back(i);
        typeCount[t]++;
    }

    // Initialize 4D DP array with large values
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>> dpTable(2,
        std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(typeCount[0] + 1,
            std::vector<std::vector<int>>(typeCount[1] + 1,
                std::vector<int>(typeCount[2] + 1, INT_MAX / 2))));

    dpTable[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int a = 0; a <= typeCount[0]; ++a) {
        for (int b = 0; b <= typeCount[1]; ++b) {
            for (int c = 0; c <= typeCount[2]; ++c) {
                for (int lastFlag = 0; lastFlag < 2; ++lastFlag) {
                    int cost = dpTable[lastFlag][a][b][c];
                    if (cost >= INT_MAX / 2) continue;

                    // Try to add 'K' (type 0)
                    if (a < typeCount[0] && lastFlag == 0) {
                        int swaps = 0, pA = typePositions[0][a];
                        for (int i = b; i < typeCount[1]; ++i)
                            if (typePositions[1][i] < pA) swaps++;
                        for (int i = c; i < typeCount[2]; ++i)
                            if (typePositions[2][i] < pA) swaps++;
                        int newA = a + 1;
                        int newB = b;
                        int newC = c;
                        int newFlag = 0;
                        if (dpTable[newFlag][newA][newB][newC] > cost + swaps)
                            dpTable[newFlag][newA][newB][newC] = cost + swaps;
                    }

                    // Try to add 'V' (type 1)
                    if (b < typeCount[1]) {
                        int swaps = 0, pB = typePositions[1][b];
                        for (int i = a; i < typeCount[0]; ++i)
                            if (typePositions[0][i] < pB) swaps++;
                        for (int i = c; i < typeCount[2]; ++i)
                            if (typePositions[2][i] < pB) swaps++;
                        int newA = a;
                        int newB = b + 1;
                        int newC = c;
                        int newFlag = 1;
                        if (dpTable[newFlag][newA][newB][newC] > cost + swaps)
                            dpTable[newFlag][newA][newB][newC] = cost + swaps;
                    }

                    // Try to add 'Z' (type 2)
                    if (c < typeCount[2]) {
                        int swaps = 0, pC = typePositions[2][c];
                        for (int i = a; i < typeCount[0]; ++i)
                            if (typePositions[0][i] < pC) swaps++;
                        for (int i = b; i < typeCount[1]; ++i)
                            if (typePositions[1][i] < pC) swaps++;
                        int newA = a;
                        int newB = b;
                        int newC = c + 1;
                        int newFlag = 0;
                        if (dpTable[newFlag][newA][newB][newC] > cost + swaps)
                            dpTable[newFlag][newA][newB][newC] = cost + swaps;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int answer = std::min(dpTable[0][typeCount[0]][typeCount[1]][typeCount[2]],
                            dpTable[1][typeCount[0]][typeCount[1]][typeCount[2]]);
    std::cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
